query: Initialize a new Ansible repo called edge-platform in ~/work/edge-platform for staging and production, hosts reached over SSH.
expected_behavior: Collects or defaults name edge-platform, environments staging and production, connection ssh
Runs scripts/init_project.py without --apply first and shows the plan before applying

Result has ansible.cfg, pyproject.toml, requirements.yml, Makefile, .ansible-lint, .yamllint, inventories/<env>/ for each environment, playbooks/site.yml, an example role with molecule scenario, .github/workflows and AGENTS.md
After applying, installs every skill under skills/ansible/ except ansible-project-init with /scaffold-repo claude (dry run first)
Runs make install, make lint and make syntax in the new repo and reports the results

query: Bootstrap an Ansible repo data-infra where EC2 hosts are reached through AWS SSM, no SSH keys.
expected_behavior: Generated inventory group_vars set ansible_connection to community.aws.aws_ssm and requirements.yml lists community.aws and amazon.aws
Deploy workflows authenticate with AWS OIDC, not stored access keys

query: Run the ansible project init in ~/work/legacy-ansible where ansible.cfg and a roles/ folder already exist.
expected_behavior: Dry run reports the existing files as conflicts and writes nothing
Does not overwrite or delete files and does not invent a force option
Asks how to proceed, for example another directory or merging by hand

query: Add a new nginx role to my existing Ansible repo.
expected_behavior: Does not use ansible-project-init because the repo already exists
Uses the role conventions of the existing repo instead of scaffolding a new project

query: After init, make lint fails in the new Ansible repo.
expected_behavior: Reads the lint output and fixes the cause in the generated files instead of adding the rule to skip_list
Re-runs make lint and make syntax until both pass and reports what changed
